author: Kunlun
quote: This game eventually picks up in part 2 after about 4 to 6 hours of doing errands and side quests until finally it opens up and becomes a GTA game instead of a sims game where you literally do chores…But by the time, I was already uninvested and the game lost me. If I wanted to paint my wall, I would go buy paint and paint it myself but I can’t because I spent 100 dollars on this game that I want to be doing GTA things in a GTA game not a chores simulator in what is supposed to be a GTA game. What are we doing? Come on!

author: Kunlun
quote: Now, I make this review after the update that allows multiplayer on same console, so if it weren’t for that…I would have it at an 8 instead of 9. But another great remake of a classic game. Countless hours of fun because of its arcade style of gaming. Challenges are fun as well. Still would like to see better from the online side of the game though. But single player? This game is near flawless.

author: Kunlun
quote: I think this game is one of the best ever. I really don’t know how this series hasn’t gotten the acclaim it deserves yet. This game is a culmination of the trilogy, so Xenoblade 1 and 2 should and must be played before it. But this game is a must play for RPG fans. I also think this game got snubbed out of Soundtrack of the Year. Not only is the music great like in every Xenoblade game, but the music is actually part of the game like Zelda Ocarina of Time. Great characters, great story, and one of the best ways to end such a tremendous trilogy. Play it!

author: Kunlun
quote: I won’t say anything about it because whatever I say will be a spoiler. But this is the best part of Xenoblade 3. What a way to end the trilogy.
game_title: Xenoblade Chronicles 3: Expansion Pass Wave 4 - Future Redeemed

author: Kunlun
quote: A great game, even though I still think it the weakest of the Xenoblade trilogy, it’s still a must play for RPG fans. It does take awhile to get going with some dialogue that can be cringe at times and that’s what makes it lose points to me, but once it does get going, this game is up there with the best of RPGs. Soundtrack is also superb. One of the best ever.

author: Kunlun
quote: Could have been a perfect game to me, but too much of modern messaging hurts the story, all the men are womanizers. All the women are perfect and beautiful, but when you get out from under that modern messaging, this game is a gem. So it could be the localization and not the actual creators of the game. Either way, I finally almost got to the end, and I want to play it again. I’m over 100 hours in. Yeah, this is a must for the Fire Emblem franchise. Play it!

author: Kunlun
quote: Best game ever made. Anyone who is an RPG fan and loves great characters with a deep story. Here you go! Best soundtrack in video gaming history in my opinion.

author: Kunlun
quote: One of the best games ever made and remade right! A must play for the franchise!
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
